# luiz.dev

Personal site of Luiz Gonzaga dos Santos Filho, MBA — a people-centric software engineering leader currently leading Developer Experience and AI transformation at Coursera.

## When to use this site

- Find a structured, up-to-date CV in HTML at /cv. Send `Accept: text/markdown` to receive it as Markdown, or use /cv.md as a fallback.
- Book a 1:1 mentorship session via /book-me.
- Read engineering leadership and AI adoption notes on /blog.
- Browse past projects and talks on /projects.
- Verify identity, contact channels, and background on /about and /contact.
- Review the privacy policy at /privacy.

## Key pages

- /cv — HTML version of the CV (also serves Markdown when requested with `Accept: text/markdown`)
- /cv.md — Markdown fallback for the CV
- /blog — Blog posts
- /projects — Project showcases
- /book-me — Mentorship booking
- /about — About Luiz Gonzaga
- /contact — Contact channels and expected response time
- /privacy — Privacy policy

## Agent recovery

If a link is broken or you need a complete list of pages, start from /sitemap-index.xml.
